proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'species_trait' kind. The tracer's top-level switch covers 'spell', 'class_feature', and 'mastery' only. Any attempt to encode this unit as a species_trait would be rejected at typecheck (not assignable to UnitRecord) and would throw 'unhandled unit kind' in the tracer.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Kind: species_trait (from task header and the survey corpus entry: "slug":"species_tiefling_fiendish_legacy","kind":"species_trait")

proposed_widenings.name: species_trait_choose_legacy
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait's core mechanic is a player choice of one of three legacies at character creation. Each legacy grants a distinct bundle (resistance type + cantrip) at L1, then different spells at L3 and L5. This 'choose one bundle from N at creation' pattern has no analogue in the existing activation/ongoing-effect/triggered-reaction/anchored-trigger families. The 'choose' procedure atom exists in v4 but there is no surface shape for a creation-time branch that conditions multiple downstream effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Choose a legacy from the Fiendish Legacies table. You gain the level 1 benefit of the chosen legacy. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance (surface shape)
proposed_widenings.justification: The atom 'grant_resistance' exists in v4 taxonomy but is not exposed in types.ts. The Abyssal legacy grants Poison resistance, Chthonic grants Necrotic resistance, Infernal grants Fire resistance. These are passive always-on resistances, requiring a surface type variant in whatever species-trait effect union is added.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You have Resistance to Poison damage." / "You have Resistance to Necrotic damage." / "You have Resistance to Fire damage."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access (surface shape)
proposed_widenings.justification: The atom 'grant_spell_access' exists in v4 taxonomy but is not exposed in types.ts. Fiendish Legacy grants a cantrip (always known) plus two leveled spells (always prepared, once-free/long-rest, also castable via spell slots). Both require a surface type for granting and preparing spells from a species trait. The leveled spells additionally carry a use_count resource (1 free cast, long-rest reset) layered over slot-based fallback — a pattern not representable in the current ClassFeatureEffect union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level."

proposed_widenings.name: character_level_gated_schedule
proposed_widenings.justification: Benefits unlock at character levels 1, 3, and 5 (not class levels). ThresholdTiers exists for use counts and dice amounts, but there is no surface shape for 'unlock new benefit at character level N' in any mechanics family. The LevelAxis type has 'character' but it is only used for DiceAmount scaling, not for gating entire effect grants.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table."

notes: Primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no 'species_trait' variant, so the unit cannot typecheck or trace at all. No Dhall or JSON authored. The secondary gaps (grant_resistance, grant_spell_access, creation-time legacy choice, character-level-gated grant schedule, spellcasting-ability choice) would each require surface widening even once the record kind exists. The spellcasting-ability choice (Int/Wis/Cha chosen at legacy selection) is an additional authoring-level parameter not representable in any current field.
